title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Premium Revision Paper #6

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Zawadi is a Kiswahili name. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. A river
   B. A road
   C. A gift
   D. A mountain

2. Which of these things was created by God, according to the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Only humans
   B. The sun, moon and stars
   C. Only the sea
   D. Only plants

3. Which action shows respect for a grandmother? (1 mark)
   A. Helping her to carry water
   B. Laughing at her
   C. Ignoring her greeting
   D. Shouting at her

4. Someone offers you sweets and asks you to keep a secret. What should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Accept and hide it
   B. Refuse and tell a trusted adult
   C. Go with them
   D. Ask for more

5. Which of these shows God's love? (1 mark)
   A. He gave us Jesus to save us
   B. He hides from people
   C. He ignores prayers
   D. He punishes for no reason

6. The Bible begins by telling us that God is: (1 mark)
   A. A teacher of the law
   B. A farmer
   C. The Creator of heaven and earth
   D. A king of Egypt

7. Which verse says that God has engraved His people on the palms of His hands? (1 mark)
   A. Acts 2:38
   B. Genesis 1:27
   C. Isaiah 49:16
   D. Luke 1:37

8. Which is the last book of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Revelation
   B. Jude
   C. Acts
   D. Malachi

9. Which New Testament book tells how the early church began? (1 mark)
   A. Acts
   B. Romans
   C. Luke
   D. Hebrews

10. In which town did Zacchaeus live? (1 mark)
   A. Bethlehem
   B. Jerusalem
   C. Nazareth
   D. Jericho

11. What did the donkey see on the road? (1 mark)
   A. A snake
   B. A wall
   C. A lion
   D. The angel of the Lord

12. What is the meaning of "bless" in this story? (1 mark)
   A. To curse
   B. To speak good things over someone
   C. To insult
   D. To ignore

13. What should a child do if they meet a dangerous animal? (1 mark)
   A. Go closer
   B. Stay away and call adults
   C. Throw stones
   D. Try to fight it

14. Why is Joseph a good example of leadership? (1 mark)
   A. He was lazy
   B. He was rude
   C. He was selfish
   D. He was honest, wise and hardworking

15. What is a famine? (1 mark)
   A. A river
   B. A festival
   C. A feast
   D. A long time when there is not enough food

16. Which city did Abram come from? (1 mark)
   A. Nazareth
   B. Jericho
   C. Jerusalem
   D. Ur

17. What did Mary answer to the angel's message? (1 mark)
   A. I do not believe you
   B. I am the Lord's servant, may your word to me be fulfilled
   C. I must ask the king
   D. Leave me

18. What name did the angel tell Mary to give her son? (1 mark)
   A. Gabriel
   B. John
   C. Jesus
   D. Emmanuel only

19. What did the angel tell Zechariah to name the baby? (1 mark)
   A. Zechariah
   B. Jesus
   C. John
   D. Gabriel

20. What does "forerunner" mean? (1 mark)
   A. A teacher of maths
   B. A king
   C. One who follows behind
   D. One who goes before to prepare

21. What did Bartimaeus call Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Son of David
   B. Priest
   C. King of Egypt
   D. Master of the house

22. What did Jesus say made Bartimaeus well? (1 mark)
   A. His cloak
   B. His shouting
   C. His faith
   D. His money

23. How many came back to thank Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Nine
   B. Ten
   C. One
   D. None

24. How did Jesus feel when He saw the widow? (1 mark)
   A. He was bored
   B. He was afraid
   C. His heart went out to her
   D. He was angry

25. What did Jesus say to the woman? (1 mark)
   A. Go home
   B. Give me water
   C. Follow me
   D. Don't cry

26. Which is an example of helping a classmate? (1 mark)
   A. Laughing at him
   B. Sharing your pencil
   C. Hiding your pencil
   D. Telling lies

27. What did she do when she found it? (1 mark)
   A. Called friends and neighbours to rejoice
   B. Sold it
   C. Ignored it
   D. Hid it

28. Why did Jesus tell the parables in Luke 15? (1 mark)
   A. To praise money
   B. To teach farming
   C. Some leaders complained that He welcomed sinners
   D. To entertain

29. What is one result of lying? (1 mark)
   A. Better marks
   B. More friends
   C. Loss of trust
   D. Peace of mind

30. Who ate the fruit God had forbidden? (1 mark)
   A. Joseph and Mary
   B. Adam and Eve
   C. Abraham and Sarah
   D. Peter and John

31. How can we show love for God? (1 mark)
   A. By being rude
   B. By ignoring them
   C. By being greedy
   D. By obeying His teachings

32. Who is your neighbour? (1 mark)
   A. Only people next door
   B. Only relatives
   C. Anyone near you or in need
   D. Only friends

33. If someone says they love you but hurts you, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore it
   B. Hurt them
   C. Keep it secret
   D. Tell a trusted adult

34. Which action shows care for school property? (1 mark)
   A. Keeping toilets clean
   B. Breaking chairs
   C. Wasting water
   D. Writing on desks

35. Why is the church called the house of God? (1 mark)
   A. It is a shop
   B. It is a school
   C. It is a holy place for worship
   D. It is a farm

36. What should you do if a group invites you to do something wrong? (1 mark)
   A. Join in
   B. Ask for more
   C. Say no, walk away and tell a trusted adult
   D. Keep it secret

37. What does "lead us not into temptation" ask? (1 mark)
   A. That God hides us
   B. That God keeps us from doing wrong
   C. That God gives gifts
   D. That God punishes us

38. Which fruit is shown by walking away instead of hitting back? (1 mark)
   A. Pride
   B. Envy
   C. Greed
   D. Self-control

39. What is a good way to limit screen time? (1 mark)
   A. Watch all day
   B. Skip meals
   C. Never sleep
   D. Do your homework first and take breaks

40. What is cyberbullying? (1 mark)
   A. Praying online
   B. Sending hurtful messages to others
   C. Sharing kind words
   D. Watching a lesson

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Describe how the early church began. (4 marks)

42. Explain how the early church shows that God's kingdom grew from a small beginning. (5 marks)

43. Describe three steps for saying no to temptation. (3 marks)

44. Give two ways of showing love at home. (2 marks)

45. Give two sins that do not please God. (2 marks)

46. Explain why we should bless and not curse others. (3 marks)

47. Explain how a child can show any five fruits of the Spirit in daily life. (5 marks)

48. Explain why Christians should show the fruit of the Holy Spirit. (3 marks)

49. Explain the meaning of the word "inspired" when we say the Bible is inspired by God. (3 marks)

50. State two things that the story of Jesus blessing children teaches. (2 marks)

51. List two attributes of God. (2 marks)

52. Give three examples of how a child can show self-control at school. (3 marks)

53. Describe how Zacchaeus met Jesus and how his behaviour changed. (4 marks)

54. State three qualities of good giving. (3 marks)

55. Name two things that Zacchaeus promised to do after meeting Jesus. (2 marks)

56. Write the first two lines of the Lord's Prayer. (2 marks)

57. State two things the angel said about John before he was born. (2 marks)

58. Give two reasons why the birth of Jesus is unique. (2 marks)

59. Explain the meaning of Proverbs 25:28. (3 marks)

60. Explain how Proverbs 1:7 helps us to understand why Joseph was so wise. (5 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — A gift
   Zawadi means a gift in Kiswahili.

2. B — The sun, moon and stars
   Genesis 1 says that God made the sun, moon and stars, and also the land, sea, plants and animals.

3. A — Helping her to carry water
   Helping shows respect and care.

4. B — Refuse and tell a trusted adult
   Gifts with secrets are a warning sign.

5. A — He gave us Jesus to save us
   John 3:16 shows God's love in giving His Son.

6. C — The Creator of heaven and earth
   Genesis 1:1 tells us God created heaven and earth.

7. C — Isaiah 49:16
   Isaiah 49:16 uses this picture to show that God does not forget us.

8. A — Revelation
   Revelation is the last book of the New Testament and of the Bible.

9. A — Acts
   The Acts of the Apostles tells the story of the early church.

10. D — Jericho
   Luke 19:1 says Jesus was passing through Jericho.

11. D — The angel of the Lord
   The angel stood in the road with a drawn sword.

12. B — To speak good things over someone
   To bless is to ask God's good for someone.

13. B — Stay away and call adults
   The story is not a call to fight animals.

14. D — He was honest, wise and hardworking
   These qualities helped him to lead Egypt well.

15. D — A long time when there is not enough food
   A famine is a serious shortage of food.

16. D — Ur
   Abram was born in Ur of the Chaldeans.

17. B — I am the Lord's servant, may your word to me be fulfilled
   Luke 1:38 records her humble answer.

18. C — Jesus
   Luke 1:31 says to call Him Jesus.

19. C — John
   Luke 1:13 says his name would be John.

20. D — One who goes before to prepare
   A forerunner goes ahead.

21. A — Son of David
   He called out, "Jesus, Son of David."

22. C — His faith
   Jesus said, "Your faith has healed you."

23. C — One
   Only one returned.

24. C — His heart went out to her
   Luke 7:13 says He had compassion.

25. D — Don't cry
   Luke 7:13 records these words.

26. B — Sharing your pencil
   Sharing meets a need.

27. A — Called friends and neighbours to rejoice
   She invited others to celebrate.

28. C — Some leaders complained that He welcomed sinners
   Jesus showed God's love for sinners.

29. C — Loss of trust
   People stop trusting a liar.

30. B — Adam and Eve
   Genesis 3 tells about Adam and Eve.

31. D — By obeying His teachings
   Jesus said love shows in obedience.

32. C — Anyone near you or in need
   A neighbour is anyone we can help.

33. D — Tell a trusted adult
   Love is never hurtful.

34. A — Keeping toilets clean
   Cleanliness respects property.

35. C — It is a holy place for worship
   Believers meet there to worship God.

36. C — Say no, walk away and tell a trusted adult
   Refuse and seek help.

37. B — That God keeps us from doing wrong
   We ask protection from temptation.

38. D — Self-control
   Self-control is controlling actions.

39. D — Do your homework first and take breaks
   Balance is important.

40. B — Sending hurtful messages to others
   Bullying can happen online.

SECTION B
----
41. (4 marks)
   Answer: The Holy Spirit came at Pentecost, Peter preached, people asked what to do, Peter told them to repent and be baptised, about three thousand believed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: Jesus began with a few disciples. On Pentecost about three thousand believed and were baptised. The church spread to many towns and countries, and today it is found in all the world including Kenya.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the few disciples, 1 for Pentecost, 1 for three thousand, 1 for spreading, 1 for today's church.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say no clearly, give a short reason, walk away, tell a trusted adult.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: Obey parents, help with chores, be kind to siblings, care for younger children.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Lying, stealing, disobedience, bullying, jealousy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: Words can build up or break down people. God wants us to love others. Blessing brings peace.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the power of words, 1 for God's wish for love, 1 for peace.

47. (5 marks)
   Answer: Love: sharing; joy: thanking God; peace: stopping quarrels; patience: waiting your turn; kindness: helping others; goodness: honesty; faithfulness: keeping promises; gentleness: speaking softly; self-control: walking away from a fight.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each fruit with an example, up to 5.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: It pleases God, makes us like Jesus, and helps us to live well with others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: Inspired means that God guided the people who wrote the books. What they wrote is His message to people, so the Bible is God's word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God guiding the writers, 1 for the message being God's, 1 for the conclusion that the Bible is God's word.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: Jesus loves children; children are important; they are welcome in God's kingdom.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: Sole Creator, loving Father, holy. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each attribute.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wait for your turn, do not fight, do homework first, do not shout, do not copy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each example.

53. (4 marks)
   Answer: Zacchaeus climbed a tree to see Jesus. Jesus called him by name and went to his house. Zacchaeus promised to give half his goods to the poor and to repay four times anyone he had cheated.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for climbing the tree, 1 for Jesus calling him, 1 for giving to the poor, 1 for repaying.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: Cheerful, quiet, respectful, useful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid quality.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: Give half his possessions to the poor and pay back four times to anyone he cheated.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each promise.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: Our Father in heaven, hallowed be your name. (The wording "who art in heaven" is also accepted.)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each line.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: He would bring joy, be great before the Lord, be filled with the Holy Spirit, and turn many to God. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: Conceived by the Holy Spirit, announced by an angel, He is the Son of God and Saviour.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: A person without self-control is like a city with broken walls, easily attacked and unprotected. Self-control protects us.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for broken walls, 1 for unprotected, 1 for self-control protecting.

60. (5 marks)
   Answer: The fear of the Lord means respect and love for God. Joseph respected God, trusted Him and obeyed Him. God gave him wisdom, so he could interpret the dream and give good advice. We too should respect God to receive wisdom.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning of the verse, 1 for Joseph respecting God, 1 for God giving wisdom, 1 for the good advice, 1 for application to us.
